export.controller: The scheme (fictional). Data protection officer: dpo@example.org
export.format: UTF-8 JSON; dates YYYY-MM-DD; instants ISO 8601 in UTC; amounts in euros as decimal strings

members.title: Membership record
members.purpose: Run your membership of the scheme: identify you, contact you, compute your rights.
members.lawful_basis: Contract (art. 6(1)(b)): your membership of the scheme.
members.source: You, and your employer when you joined.
members.recipients: Your employer (membership status and dates only).

contributions.title: Contributions
contributions.purpose: Record the contributions paid for you, which your benefits are computed from.
contributions.lawful_basis: Contract (art. 6(1)(b)); kept afterwards under a legal obligation (art. 6(1)(c)) for pension and tax records.
contributions.recipients: Your employer (reconciliation); the tax authority (yearly statement).

bank_accounts.title: Bank account
bank_accounts.recipients: Our bank, when a payment is made.

beneficiaries.title: Beneficiaries
beneficiaries.purpose: Pay a death benefit to the people you designated.
beneficiaries.recipients: None outside the scheme until a benefit is paid.

consents.title: Consents
consents.purpose: Prove what you agreed to and when you withdrew it.
consents.lawful_basis: Legal obligation (art. 6(1)(c) with art. 7(1)): we must be able to show your consent.

support_tickets.title: Support requests
support_tickets.source: You, and our support staff's answers.
support_tickets.retention: 2 years after the ticket was closed

rows.subject: Change of bank details
rows.body: Hello, I changed banks: my new IBAN is in my profile. Alex

rows.subject: Question about my 2024 annual statement
rows.body: Hello, March 2024 seems to be missing from my statement. Alex

rows.subject: What data do you hold about me?
rows.body: Hello, I would like a copy of my data. Alex

sessions.title: Sign-in sessions
sessions.purpose: Keep you signed in, and ask for your password again before sensitive actions.
sessions.source: Recorded by the portal when you sign in.

login_events.title: Sign-in history
login_events.purpose: Detect and investigate unauthorised access to your account.
login_events.lawful_basis: Legitimate interests (art. 6(1)(f)): security of the portal.
login_events.source: Recorded by the portal when you sign in.

dsar_requests.title: Your data requests
dsar_requests.purpose: Answer your requests about your data, within the legal deadline, and show that we did.
dsar_requests.lawful_basis: Legal obligation (art. 6(1)(c) with art. 12 and art. 5(2)).
dsar_requests.source: Recorded when you make a request.
dsar_requests.retention: 3 years after the request was answered

dsar_events.title: Your data requests: timeline
dsar_events.purpose: Show each step of handling your requests.
dsar_events.source: Recorded while your request is handled.
dsar_events.retention: 3 years after the request was answered

rows.detail: access (art. 15) and portability (art. 20), through the portal

withheld.reason: Personal data of another person (art. 15(4)): you designated them, so their name and share are shown, but not their date of birth.
A secret derived from your password: giving it out would weaken your account's security, and it says nothing about you.
A hash of a live credential: it is left out for your account's security.
May be restricted while a claim is pending where disclosure would prejudice it (art. 23 and national law); reviewed by the data protection officer case by case.
